title: The Fourth Walking With Them
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of the brave start, and tonight three friends refuse to bow and walk into the fire together. Holding his little sister’s hand in the dark and telling her “We are not alone” is exactly the courage the furnace asks for.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because the three friends stood brave together, and bravery is Beau’s whole heart. In Beau’s world today: the lights go out in a summer storm, and his little sister starts to cry. Beau holds her hand in the dark and tells her, “We are not alone,” until the lamps hum back on. Just like the friends finding someone walking beside them in the fire, Beau learned that Heavenly Father is with us in the dark.
